sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《Hidden Brain》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: For decades, this was the sound of mornings in America.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这就是美国清晨的声音。

sentences.en: Millions of people waking up to the thud of a newspaper on their front step.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的人在报纸掉落在门阶上的沉闷声中醒来。

sentences.en: But increasingly, this sounds quaint.
sentences.zh: 但这种声音正变得越来越古怪。

sentences.en: Even longtime subscribers, the people who love the feel of a newspaper in their hands
sentences.zh: 即使是长期订阅者，那些喜欢手里拿着报纸的感觉、

sentences.en: as they sip their morning coffee, many have decided to cancel.
sentences.zh: 一边啜饮晨间咖啡一边阅读的人，许多也决定取消订阅了。

sentences.en: I used to get the Denver Post delivered, even after it was online.
sentences.zh: 我以前一直订《丹佛邮报》，即使它有了在线版也是如此。

sentences.en: I just liked having the paper, but then I found I wasn't actually reading it.
sentences.zh: 我只是喜欢拥有报纸的感觉，但后来我发现我并没有真正去读它。

sentences.en: It would just kind of pile up and I'd recycle it, so I let that lapse.
sentences.zh: 它只会堆在那里，最后被我拿去回收，所以我让订阅过期了。

sentences.en: Denver used to have two vibrant morning papers.
sentences.zh: 丹佛曾经有两份充满活力的晨报。

sentences.en: In the last few years, many residents stopped getting a local paper.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，许多居民不再订阅当地报纸。

sentences.en: Some switched to reading online.
sentences.zh: 有些人转为在线阅读。

sentences.en: Others never had a subscription in the first place.
sentences.zh: 另一些人本来就从未订阅过。

sentences.en: I've never subscribed to a local publication.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有订阅过当地的出版物。

sentences.en: I usually just get the free ones like Westward.
sentences.zh: 我通常只拿像《Westward》这样的免费报纸。

sentences.en: Westward, the free one that comes out in the little red bins all over Denver.
sentences.zh: 《Westward》，就是丹佛随处可见的红色小报箱里那种免费报纸。

sentences.en: Love the coupons.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢里面的优惠券。

sentences.en: That's what I wanted the paper for, is the coupons.
sentences.zh: 我订报纸就是为了优惠券。

sentences.en: And I mean, Facebook has everything, so yeah.
sentences.zh: 而且我的意思是，Facebook上什么都有，所以，是的。

sentences.en: There are lots of options today to pay less or nothing to read the news.
sentences.zh: 如今有很多选择可以让你花更少的钱甚至不花钱就能读到新闻。

sentences.en: There are free blogs, there's Facebook and Twitter.
sentences.zh: 有免费的博客，还有Facebook和Twitter。

sentences.en: Who needs a subscription to a local paper?
sentences.zh: 谁还需要订阅当地报纸呢？

sentences.en: Millions of Americans have decided they don't.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的美国人已经决定他们不需要了。

sentences.en: Why subscribe if you don't have time to read the paper?
sentences.zh: 如果你没时间看报，为什么要订阅呢？

sentences.en: If you think the paper is biased?
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得报纸有偏见呢？

sentences.en: If you want to save money?
sentences.zh: 如果你想省钱呢？

sentences.en: All this makes rational sense.
sentences.zh: 这一切在理性上都说得通。

sentences.en: Except, it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: That's because newspapers are not like most things we buy.
sentences.zh: 这是因为报纸不像我们购买的大多数商品。

sentences.en: If I decide not to buy a watch, I save money.
sentences.zh: 如果我决定不买手表，我就省了钱。

sentences.en: But if I decide not to pay for a police department,
sentences.zh: 但如果我决定不为警察局买单，

sentences.en: I might save money in the short run,
sentences.zh: 短期内我可能省了钱，

sentences.en: but end up paying more in the long run.
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，我最终付出的代价会更多。

sentences.en: Most of us treat newspapers like consumer products,
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人把报纸当作消费品来对待，

sentences.en: but new research suggests they might be more like police departments.
sentences.zh: 但新的研究表明，它们可能更像警察局。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain,
sentences.zh: 本周的《Hidden Brain》，

sentences.en: who bears the cost when nobody wants to pay?
sentences.zh: 当没人愿意买单时，谁来承担成本？

sentences.en: In the winter of 2009,
a few Denver-based reporters headed to a region of mountains and canyons
sentences.zh: 几名驻丹佛的记者前往一个山峦和峡谷密布的地区，

sentences.en: called the Rhone Plateau.
sentences.zh: 那里被称为罗恩高原。

sentences.en: Just a few years earlier, it was the site of an oil and gas boom.
sentences.zh: 就在几年前，那里还是石油和天然气繁荣的中心。

sentences.en: But that boom had turned into a buSt.
sentences.zh: 但那种繁荣已经变成了萧条。

sentences.en: So we were going up the Rome Plateau where many fewer workers were employed
sentences.zh: 所以我们前往罗恩高原，那里雇佣的工人已经少了很多，

sentences.en: and looking at how people were struggling to try to keep things going and make ends meet.
sentences.zh: 去看看人们是如何挣扎着维持生计的。

sentences.en: Laura Frank was an investigative reporter for the Rocky Mountain News.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·弗兰克是《落基山新闻报》的一名调查记者。

sentences.en: We were riding up with some of the oil and gas workers
sentences.zh: 我们和一些油气工人一起乘车，

sentences.en: trying to get up the plateau.
sentences.zh: 试图登上高原。

sentences.en: It had rained, and so the dirt road going up the plateau had turned
sentences.zh: 当时下过雨，通往高原的土路已经变成了，

sentences.en: really into kind of a muddy mess.
sentences.zh: 一片泥泞的烂摊子。

sentences.en: And here we are sliding in this pickup truck trying to get up the
sentences.zh: 我们坐在皮卡车里打滑，试图登上

sentences.en: plateau when suddenly we see these semi-trucks coming down the same road and not sure what kind
sentences.zh: 高原，突然看到这些半挂卡车从同一条路上开下来，不知道它们是否

sentences.en: of control they were under.
sentences.zh: 还在控制之中。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking, why am I risking my life for a newspaper that's about
sentences.zh: 我在想，为什么我要冒着生命危险去为一份即将

sentences.en: to close.
sentences.zh: 倒闭的报纸工作。

sentences.en: A newspaper that was about to close.
sentences.zh: 一份即将倒闭的报纸。

sentences.en: Laura was worried about the Rocky.
sentences.zh: 劳拉很担心《落基山新闻报》的命运。

sentences.en: Several weeks
sentences.zh: 几周前，

sentences.en: earlier, a balding man in a suit had stood in the middle of her newsroom.
sentences.zh: 一个秃顶的西装男站在她新闻编辑部的中央。

sentences.en: Reporters and editors
sentences.zh: 记者和编辑们

sentences.en: clustered around in a circle.
sentences.zh: 围成一个圈。

sentences.en: Many had their arms crossed.
sentences.zh: 许多人交叉着双臂。

sentences.en: Some scribbled in notebooks.
sentences.zh: 有些人正在笔记本上乱涂乱画。

sentences.en: This is a
sentences.zh: 这里是

sentences.en: newsroom, so I doubt I actually need to give you the headline.
sentences.zh: 新闻编辑部，所以我怀疑我其实不需要给你们念头条。

sentences.en: Most of you probably already know,
sentences.zh: 你们大多数人可能已经知道了，

sentences.en: but we're going to announce just in the next few minutes
sentences.zh: 但我们将在接下来的几分钟内宣布，

sentences.en: that we're going to put the Rocky Mountain News up for sale.
sentences.zh: 我们要将《落基山新闻报》挂牌出售。

sentences.en: Laura had listened to the announcement with dismay.
sentences.zh: 劳拉怀着沮丧的心情听完了这个公告。

sentences.en: The newspaper was going to either be sold in the next 30 days
sentences.zh: 报纸要么在未来30天内被卖掉，

sentences.en: or it would be closed.
sentences.zh: 要么就会倒闭。

sentences.en: And if you remember what was happening in December of 2008,
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得2008年12月发生了什么，

sentences.en: we knew we were on the verge either of a Great Recession
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们正处于大衰退

sentences.en: or the next Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 或下一次大萧条的边缘。

sentences.en: So I was pretty sure that they probably weren't going to sell
sentences.zh: 所以我很确定，他们大概不会在假期里的30天内卖掉

sentences.en: the newspaper over the holidays in 30 days when no one knew what the economic outlook was really
sentences.zh: 这份报纸，当时没人知道经济前景究竟

sentences.en: going to be.
sentences.zh: 会怎样。

sentences.en: Days after her reporting trip to the Rhone Plateau, Laura got word about her fate
sentences.zh: 在前往罗恩高原报道后的几天，劳拉得到了关于她在《落基山新闻报》

sentences.en: at the Rocky.
sentences.zh: 命运的消息。

sentences.en: The corporate managers had flown in and, you know, you're in a big and sophisticated
sentences.zh: 公司高管们飞了过来，你知道，你身处一个庞大而复杂的

sentences.en: newsroom.
sentences.zh: 新闻编辑部。

sentences.en: We knew they had landed.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们已经降落了。

sentences.en: People had sources at the airport.
sentences.zh: 人们在机场有消息来源。

sentences.en: We knew they were there
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们在那儿，

sentences.en: and we pretty much knew what they were going to say.
sentences.zh: 我们也基本知道他们要说什么。

sentences.en: The same balding man in a suit gathered journalists around him.
sentences.zh: 同一个秃顶的西装男把记者们召集在他周围。

sentences.en: Tomorrow will be the final edition of the Rocky Mountain News.
sentences.zh: 明天将是《落基山新闻报》的最后一期。

sentences.en: Certainly not good news for any of you and certainly not good news for Denver.
sentences.zh: 这对你们任何一个人来说肯定都不是好消息，对丹佛来说也肯定不是好消息。

sentences.en: I just want to make sure and say it's certainly nothing you did.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确保说明，这绝对不是你们的错。

sentences.en: You all did everything right.
sentences.zh: 你们所有人都做得很好。

sentences.en: But while you were out doing your part, the business model and the economy changed
sentences.zh: 但当你们在尽职尽责时，商业模式和经济发生了变化，

sentences.en: and the Rocky became a victim of that.
sentences.zh: 而《落基山新闻报》成了其中的牺牲品。

sentences.en: that Denver can't support two newspapers any longer,
sentences.zh: 丹佛再也无法支撑两份报纸了，

sentences.en: especially two morning, full distribution, general interest newspapers.
sentences.zh: 尤其是两份全天候、全面发行、大众兴趣的报纸。

sentences.en: It just can't happen.
sentences.zh: 这根本不可能。

sentences.en: It was very hard to leave that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上离开时非常艰难。

sentences.en: I remember sitting at my desk for a very long time,
sentences.zh: 我记得我在办公桌前坐了很长时间，

sentences.en: just sitting there and not, you know, I was finished.
sentences.zh: 只是坐在那里，你知道，我结束了。

sentences.en: There was nothing more I could do, but I didn't want to walk out of there.
sentences.zh: 我无能为力了，但我不想从那里走出去。

sentences.en: The story about the oil and gas bus that Laura had spent weeks working on?
sentences.zh: 劳拉花了数周时间报道的关于油气萧条的故事？

sentences.en: It was scheduled to run that Saturday.
sentences.zh: 原定于那个周六刊登。

sentences.en: The Rocky closed one day earlier, on Friday.
sentences.zh: 《落基山新闻报》提前一天，在周五就倒闭了。

sentences.en: When Laura left the Rocky newsroom for the last time,
sentences.zh: 当劳拉最后一次离开《落基山新闻报》的编辑部时，

sentences.en: she was concerned about her own future,
sentences.zh: 她担心自己的未来，

sentences.en: but she was even more concerned about the work she had left undone.
sentences.zh: 但她更担心自己未完成的工作。

sentences.en: I had all of these stacks of documents on my desk at the Rocky Mountain News,
sentences.zh: 我在《落基山新闻报》的办公桌上堆满了文件，

sentences.en: each representing some issue that I thought needed investigating.
sentences.zh: 每一份都代表着我认为需要调查的问题。

sentences.en: One of those issues was electronics waste, or e-waste.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题是电子垃圾，即“电子废弃物”。

sentences.en: The very week that the Rocky Mountain News closed, that last week of February in 2009,
sentences.zh: 就在《落基山新闻报》倒闭的那一周，即2009年2月的最后一周，

sentences.en: federal agents had raided an electronics recycler.
sentences.zh: 联邦特工突袭了一家电子回收商。

sentences.en: That raid came after a dramatic investigation by 60 Minutes.
sentences.zh: 那次突袭是在《60分钟》节目进行了一项引人注目的调查之后发生的。

sentences.en: Tonight, we're going to take you to one of the most toxic places on Earth,
sentences.zh: 今晚，我们将带你们去地球上最毒的地方之一，

sentences.en: a place that government officials and gangsters don't want you to see.
sentences.zh: 一个政府官员和黑帮都不想让你们看到的地方。

sentences.en: A 60 Minutes investigation alleged this company had sent e-waste to China,
sentences.zh: 《60分钟》的一项调查指控该公司将电子垃圾运往中国，

sentences.en: where people were dipping parts in acid and burning them over open flames
sentences.zh: 在那里，人们把零件浸在酸液中，并在明火上焚烧，

sentences.en: to get little bits of gold and other metals.
sentences.zh: 以获取少量的黄金和其他金属。

sentences.en: And they were exposing the village to dangerous levels of lead.
sentences.zh: 他们让整个村庄暴露在危险水平的铅污染中。

sentences.en: In fact, 70% of the kids in that village had dangerous levels of lead in their blood.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那个村子里70%的孩子血液中的铅含量都达到了危险水平。

sentences.en: So here you had an ongoing federal investigation into the role a Colorado company allegedly played in endangering kids in a foreign nation, and my newspaper was shutting down.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时联邦政府正在调查一家科罗拉多州公司在危害外国儿童方面所扮演的角色，而我的报纸却要倒闭了。

sentences.en: We couldn't investigate, but the worst thing was no other local media had the capacity to investigate it either.
sentences.zh: 我们无法进行调查，但最糟糕的是，其他当地媒体也没有能力进行调查。

sentences.en: What happens when a newspaper isn't around to dig into stories of corruption and malfeasance?
sentences.zh: 当没有报纸去挖掘腐败和渎职的故事时会发生什么？

sentences.en: Like millions of people around the country,
sentences.zh: 就像全国数以百万计的人一样，

sentences.en: Denver's residents decided not to subscribe to their local newspaper
sentences.zh: 丹佛的居民决定不再订阅当地报纸，

sentences.en: for what seemed like perfectly good reasons.
sentences.zh: 理由看起来非常充分。

sentences.en: They were busy.
sentences.zh: 他们很忙。

sentences.en: The news was depressing.
sentences.zh: 新闻很压抑。

sentences.en: The paper was expensive.
sentences.zh: 报纸很贵。

sentences.en: But these rational choices as consumers
sentences.zh: 但这些作为消费者的理性选择，

sentences.en: turned out to have serious consequences for them
sentences.zh: 最终却给他们作为纳税人和公民，

sentences.en: as taxpayers and citizens.
sentences.zh: 带来了严重的后果。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: There's a graph that I saw years ago
sentences.zh: 我多年前看到过一张图表，

sentences.en: that stood out to me so much
sentences.zh: 它给我留下了深刻的印象，

sentences.en: that I now have it pinned to the wall in my office.
sentences.zh: 以至于我现在把它钉在办公室的墙上。

sentences.en: It has a red line and a blue line.
sentences.zh: 它有一条红线和一条蓝线。

sentences.en: The red represents newspaper advertising revenue.
sentences.zh: 红线代表报纸的广告收入。

sentences.en: The blue shows the number of newspaper reporters in the country.
sentences.zh: 蓝线显示全国报纸记者的数量。

sentences.en: From 1980 to the early 2000s,
sentences.zh: 从1980年到21世纪初，

sentences.en: ad revenue, the red line, rose and rose and rose.
sentences.zh: 广告收入，即红线，不断上升。

sentences.en: It peaked in the early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 它在21世纪初达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: Then there was a cliff.
sentences.zh: 然后出现了一个悬崖。

sentences.en: As people canceled subscriptions and advertising revenue plummeted, so did the number of reporters.
sentences.zh: 随着人们取消订阅和广告收入暴跌，记者人数也随之下降。

sentences.en: The blue line.
sentences.zh: 也就是蓝线。

sentences.en: Between 2006 and 2014, some 20,000 newspaper journalists lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 在2006年到2014年间，约有2万名报纸记者失去了工作。

sentences.en: Now you can say, this is how capitalism works.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以说，这就是资本主义的运作方式。

sentences.en: Industries shrink, others grow.
sentences.zh: 行业萎缩，其他行业增长。

sentences.en: But is it possible that newspapers don't fit neatly into this economic model?
sentences.zh: 但报纸是否可能并不完全符合这种经济模式？

sentences.en: that they have a different kind of effect on their communities.
sentences.zh: 它们对社区有着不同类型的影响。

sentences.en: Finance professors Paul Gao, Dermot Murphy, and Chang Li
sentences.zh: 金融学教授保罗·高、德莫特·墨菲和张力

sentences.en: were thinking about the effect of newspapers shutting down
sentences.zh: 正在思考报纸倒闭的影响。

sentences.en: when they spotted something on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 当他们在 YouTube 上发现了一些东西时。

sentences.en: We were watching this segment from this TV show called Last Week Tonight
sentences.zh: 我们当时正在看一档名为《上周今夜秀》的电视节目片段，

sentences.en: with John Oliver about the state of the local newspaper in the United States.
sentences.zh: 主持人是约翰·奥利弗，讨论的是美国地方报纸的现状。

sentences.en: This is Dermot Murphy.
sentences.zh: 这位是德莫特·墨菲。

sentences.en: John Oliver was explaining what Americans lose when newspapers disappear.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥利弗在解释报纸消失后美国人会失去什么。

sentences.en: Watch how often TV news ends up citing print sources.
sentences.zh: 看看电视新闻引用印刷媒体来源的频率有多高。

sentences.en: According to the Chicago Tribune.
sentences.zh: 据《芝加哥论坛报》报道。

sentences.en: According to the Detroit Free Press.
sentences.zh: 据《底特律自由新闻报》报道。

sentences.en: According to the San Francisco Chronicle.
sentences.zh: 据《旧金山纪事报》报道。

sentences.en: According to the Times-Picayune.
sentences.zh: 据《时代皮卡尤恩报》报道。

sentences.en: The Boston Globe.
sentences.zh: 《波士顿环球报》。

sentences.en: The Orlando Sentinel.
sentences.zh: 《奥兰多哨兵报》。

sentences.en: The Philadelphia Inquirer.
sentences.zh: 《费城问询报》。

sentences.en: The Pittsburgh Tribune Review.
sentences.zh: 《匹兹堡论坛评论报》。

sentences.en: The Detroit News.
sentences.zh: 《底特律新闻报》。

sentences.en: And the Houston Chronicle Reports.
sentences.zh: 以及《休斯顿纪事报》的报道。

sentences.en: The Los Angeles Times Reports.
sentences.zh: 《洛杉矶时报》的报道。

sentences.en: The Oklahoman Reports.
sentences.zh: 《俄克拉荷马人报》的报道。

sentences.en: The Hartford Courant Reports.
sentences.zh: 《哈特福德新闻报》的报道。

sentences.en: The Salt Lake Tribune Reports.
sentences.zh: 《盐湖城论坛报》的报道。

sentences.en: It's pretty obvious, without newspapers around to cite,
sentences.zh: 显而易见，如果没有报纸可供引用，

sentences.en: TV news would just be Wolf Blitzer
sentences.zh: 电视新闻就只会是沃尔夫·布利策

sentences.en: endlessly batting a ball of yarn around.
sentences.zh: 无休止地拨弄着一团毛线球。

sentences.en: So as finance professors, we thought it would be important to look at the effect of newspaper closures on local communities from the finance angle.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为金融学教授，我们认为从金融角度审视报纸倒闭对当地社区的影响非常重要。

sentences.en: The researchers had a hunch that the loss of newspaper jobs could affect municipal finance.
sentences.zh: 研究人员直觉地认为，报纸职位的流失可能会影响市政财政。

sentences.en: Now that sounds wonky, but let me explain why this is actually a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能很枯燥，但我来解释一下为什么这其实是一件大事。

sentences.en: Just as you borrow money from a bank to buy a house, towns and cities borrow money to build police stations, senior centers, and bridges.
sentences.zh: 就像你从银行贷款买房一样，城镇也会借钱来建造警察局、老年中心和桥梁。

sentences.en: Taxpayers pay off these loans over time, just as homeowners pay off their mortgages.
sentences.zh: 纳税人会随着时间推移偿还这些贷款，就像房主偿还抵押贷款一样。

sentences.en: Dermott thought there might be a relationship between the cost of loans to cities and towns
sentences.zh: 德莫特认为，城市和城镇的贷款成本

sentences.en: and disappearing newspapers.
sentences.zh: 与报纸的消失之间可能存在某种联系。

sentences.en: The researchers tallied every time a newspaper shut down between 1996 and 2015,
sentences.zh: 研究人员统计了 1996 年至 2015 年间每一家报纸倒闭的情况，

sentences.en: they found 200 counties across the United States where there was a decline in the number of newspapers.
sentences.zh: 他们在美国各地发现了 200 个报纸数量减少的县。

sentences.en: They compared these counties to similar counties in the same state
sentences.zh: 他们将这些县与同一州内报纸业繁荣的类似县进行了比较。

sentences.en: where newspapers were thriving.
sentences.zh: 报纸业繁荣的县。

sentences.zh: 我们就能基本看出政府借贷成本在报纸倒闭后的长期增长情况。

sentences.en: in the long run after a newspaper closure.
sentences.zh: 在报纸倒闭后的长期影响中。

sentences.en: Dermot and his colleagues found that when a newspaper closed,
sentences.zh: 德莫特和他的同事发现，当一家报纸倒闭时，

sentences.en: the cost of loans in its county went up.
sentences.zh: 该县的贷款成本就会上升。

sentences.en: This happened all over the country, including in Denver,
sentences.zh: 这种情况在全国各地都有发生，包括丹佛，

sentences.en: home of the now-closed Rocky Mountain News.
sentences.zh: 这里曾是现已倒闭的《落基山新闻报》的所在地。

sentences.en: Dermot says one deceptively tiny number tells a significant story.
sentences.zh: 德莫特说，一个看似微小的数字讲述了一个重要的故事。

sentences.en: In the long run, after a newspaper closes, the borrowing cost for governments increases by about 0.1%.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，报纸倒闭后，政府的借贷成本会增加约 0.1%。

sentences.en: Now, the interest rate on a loan increasing from, say, 3% to 3.1% may not sound like much.
sentences.zh: 贷款利率从比如 3% 增加到 3.1%，听起来可能不算什么。

sentences.en: But here's how it adds up.
sentences.zh: 但这就是累积起来的结果。

sentences.en: On average, a loan will be for $65 million in our sample.
sentences.zh: 在我们的样本中，平均每笔贷款为 6500 万美元。

sentences.en: If the cost of a loan goes up by 0.1%, that's about $65,000 more that taxpayers have to pay.
sentences.zh: 如果贷款成本上升 0.1%，纳税人就得多支付约 6.5 万美元。

sentences.en: $65,000 more every year.
sentences.zh: 每年多支付 6.5 万美元。

sentences.en: If the life of a loan is 10 years, that's about $650,000.
sentences.zh: 如果贷款期限为 10 年，那就是约 65 万美元。

sentences.en: And that's just for one loan.
sentences.zh: 而这还只是一笔贷款。

sentences.en: Cities and towns often have many loans like this.
sentences.zh: 城市和城镇通常有很多这样的贷款。

sentences.en: If a city has five projects, that's more than $3 million.
sentences.zh: 如果一个城市有五个项目，那就是超过 300 万美元。

sentences.en: If it has 50 projects, it's more than $30 million.
sentences.zh: 如果有 50 个项目，那就是超过 3000 万美元。

sentences.en: That does add up to real costs for the taxpayer.
sentences.zh: 这确实给纳税人增加了实实在在的成本。

sentences.en: The effect showed up even after the researchers controlled for population growth and differences in local economies.
sentences.zh: 即使在研究人员控制了人口增长和当地经济差异后，这种影响依然存在。

sentences.en: It affected areas that were booming and areas that were shrinking.

sentences.en: Dermot thinks that borrowing costs go up because something important disappears when newspapers close.
sentences.zh: 德莫特认为借贷成本上升是因为报纸倒闭时，某种重要的东西消失了。

sentences.en: The Watchdog Channel.

sentences.en: The watchdog role that journalists play in holding public officials and powerful corporations accountable.
sentences.zh: 记者在监督公职人员和强大企业方面所扮演的“看门狗”角色。

sentences.en: When a newspaper closes or slashes its reporting staff, there's no one to play that role anymore.

sentences.en: It's like getting rid of the police officers who patrol neighborhoods.

sentences.en: Dermot thinks the absence of watchdogs affects loan prices because banks realize their loans to local governments are now a little more risky.

sentences.en: They know that some government officials will now be a little less honest, a little less careful.

sentences.en: Lenders are a little more nervous about lending to such a government.

sentences.en: then they're going to have to ask for a higher interest rate on the money they're lending to compensate for that risk.

sentences.en: After the Rocky shut down, Laura started her own journalism outlet.
sentences.zh: 在《洛基山新闻报》倒闭后，劳拉创办了自己的新闻机构。

sentences.en: I wound up actually being given a fellowship at the University of Colorado.
sentences.zh: 我最终在科罗拉多大学获得了一份研究员职位。

sentences.en: Ironically, the Scripps Fellowship, named for the same family that owned the Rocky.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，这个斯克里普斯（Scripps）研究员职位，正是以当年拥有《洛基山新闻报》的同一个家族命名的。

sentences.en: She used the Scripps money to create an organization called iNews.
sentences.zh: 她利用斯克里普斯的资金创建了一个名为iNews的组织。

sentences.en: And the I stood for investigative.
sentences.zh: 其中的“I”代表调查。

sentences.en: And the idea was that we would do investigative stories and share them with other newsrooMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的想法是进行调查报道，并与其他新闻编辑室分享。

sentences.en: And that's what we did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实做到了。

sentences.en: Remember the story about e-waste that Laura never got to finish when she was at the Rocky?
sentences.zh: 还记得劳拉在《洛基山新闻报》时从未完成的那篇关于电子垃圾的报道吗？

sentences.en: That was the first story.
sentences.zh: 那就是第一篇报道。

sentences.en: I put a reporter on the story who spoke Mandarin.
sentences.zh: 我安排了一位会说普通话的记者负责这个故事。

sentences.en: And using a couple of different databases, we were able to track a shipment of e-waste from Colorado to Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 利用几个不同的数据库，我们追踪到了一批从科罗拉多州运往香港的电子垃圾。

sentences.en: And our reporter was then able to confirm that this e-waste had been illegally exported.
sentences.zh: 我们的记者随后证实，这些电子垃圾是非法出口的。

sentences.en: And that would have been an important story if we had stopped right there to say, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果我们到此为止，说，你知道，

sentences.en: despite an ongoing federal investigation, illegal e-waste is still being exported to foreign nations.
sentences.zh: 尽管联邦调查仍在进行，非法电子垃圾仍被出口到国外，那这已经是一个重要的报道了。

sentences.en: But we didn't stop there.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有就此止步。

sentences.en: We found that some of the same kinds of dangerous practices that were happening in China and Hong Kong,
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在中国和香港发生的那些危险做法，

sentences.en: like dipping parts in acid and burning them over open flames,
sentences.zh: 比如把零件浸在酸液中，或者在露天火焰上焚烧，

sentences.en: it was happening right here in Colorado on a much smaller scale,
sentences.zh: 在科罗拉多州这里也以小得多的规模发生着，

sentences.en: but completely under the radar of state regulators.
sentences.zh: 但完全处于州监管机构的视野之外。

sentences.en: They had no idea it was happening.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And so that would have been an important part of the story.
sentences.zh: 所以那本会是报道中重要的一部分。

sentences.en: But we didn't stop there either.
sentences.zh: 但我们也没有就此止步。

sentences.en: we found that most of Colorado's used electronic waste was actually winding up in local dumps
sentences.zh: 我们发现科罗拉多州大部分废旧电子垃圾实际上最终都被扔进了当地垃圾填埋场，

sentences.en: instead of being recycled.
sentences.zh: 而不是被回收利用。

sentences.en: And again, I feel like one of those commercials, but that's not all.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我感觉自己像是在做广告，但这还不是全部。

sentences.en: We didn't stop there.
sentences.zh: 我们没有就此止步。

sentences.en: We found much of the e-waste that was being illegally exported,
sentences.zh: 我们发现许多被非法出口、

sentences.en: locally dumped, or dipped and burned in Coloradans' backyards was actually coming from
sentences.zh: 在当地倾倒，或在科罗拉多人的后院被浸泡和焚烧的电子垃圾，实际上来自

sentences.en: government surplus auctions.
sentences.zh: 政府的剩余物资拍卖。

sentences.en: In fact, the very state agency responsible for regulating e-waste
sentences.zh: 事实上，负责监管电子垃圾的州政府机构本身，

sentences.en: was sending its own trash electronics to auction.
sentences.zh: 就在把自己的废旧电子产品送去拍卖。

sentences.en: That is unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人难以置信。

sentences.en: They shared their reporting with news outlets across Colorado.
sentences.zh: 他们与科罗拉多州各地的媒体分享了他们的报道。

sentences.en: She dug into the story of what happens to old computers for iNews.
sentences.zh: 她为iNews深入挖掘了旧电脑去向的故事。

sentences.en: It's a non-profit investigative outfit in Denver.
sentences.zh: 这是一个位于丹佛的非营利性调查机构。

sentences.en: Some of the government's trash computers wind up being shipped to developing nations,
sentences.zh: 一些政府的废旧电脑最终被运往发展中国家，

sentences.en: sent to the local dump, and even dismantled here in people's backyards and garages.
sentences.zh: 被送到当地垃圾场，甚至在人们的后院和车库里被拆解。

sentences.en: The response was even greater than if the story had been published in just one newspaper.
sentences.zh: 其反响比仅在一家报纸上发表报道要大得多。

sentences.en: Because of the way we were approaching this in a collaborative way instead of a competitive way,
sentences.zh: 因为我们采取的是协作而非竞争的方式来处理这件事，

sentences.en: the story of Colorado's e-waste went from being a story that no media had the capacity to cover
sentences.zh: 科罗拉多州电子垃圾的故事从一个没有媒体有能力报道的故事，

sentences.en: to a story that every major news outlet could share with their audience.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个每家主要新闻媒体都能与受众分享的故事。

sentences.en: It was in every daily paper.
sentences.zh: 它出现在每一份日报上。

sentences.en: It was on television.
sentences.zh: 它出现在电视上。

sentences.en: It was on the radio.
sentences.zh: 它出现在广播里。

sentences.en: So suddenly we had this statewide conversation about what was actually happening to Colorado's e-waste, and that had never happened before.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，我们有了一场全州范围的对话，讨论科罗拉多州的电子垃圾到底发生了什么，这在以前从未发生过。

sentences.en: And the state legislature then moved to close some of the loopholes that were allowing this to happen.
sentences.zh: 随后，州议会采取行动，堵住了导致这种情况发生的一些漏洞。

sentences.en: So that's, you know, that's the way the fourth estate in a democracy is supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这就是民主制度下第四权力应该发挥的作用。

sentences.en: This is clearly a success story.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个成功的故事。

sentences.en: Laura lost her job at the Rocky, but that led her to set up iNews.
sentences.zh: 劳拉在《洛基山新闻报》丢了工作，但这促使她创办了iNews。

sentences.en: She got stories like the e-waste investigation out to the public.
sentences.zh: 她把像电子垃圾调查这样的报道公之于众。

sentences.en: The government made changes to the program in response.
sentences.zh: 政府对此做出了回应，对项目进行了调整。

sentences.en: But Laura still thinks there is an immense cost when a newspaper closes.
sentences.zh: 但劳拉仍然认为，报纸倒闭会带来巨大的代价。

sentences.en: It took two years for us to get the story out.
sentences.zh: 我们花了两年时间才把这个故事报道出来。

sentences.en: so how many children were exposed
sentences.zh: 那么有多少孩子受到了影响，

sentences.en: and wound up with high levels of lead in their blood
sentences.zh: 并导致血液中铅含量升高，

sentences.en: while we were trying to figure out a way
sentences.zh: 而在我们试图寻找方法

sentences.en: to get the story out
sentences.zh: 把这个故事报道出来的时候，

sentences.en: yes I think when there's a really important story
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为当有一个非常重要的故事，

sentences.en: that a journalist somehow finds out about

sentences.en: it will eventually get out
sentences.zh: 它最终会公之于众，

sentences.en: One of the bedrock assumptions of economics
sentences.zh: 经济学的基石假设之一是，

sentences.en: is that when individuals behave rationally,
sentences.zh: 当个人理性行事时，

sentences.en: good things happen to them.
sentences.zh: 好事就会发生在他们身上。

sentences.en: Good things happen to their communities, their society.
sentences.zh: 好事会发生在他们的社区、他们的社会身上。

sentences.en: The invisible hand of the market
sentences.zh: 市场的“看不见的手”，

sentences.en: takes all of our rational, selfish decisions
sentences.zh: 吸收了我们所有理性的、自私的决定，

sentences.en: and produces a society that flourishes.
sentences.zh: 并创造了一个繁荣的社会。

sentences.en: Much of the time, this does work.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，这确实有效。

sentences.en: But it turns out that for things like police departments,
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，对于警察部门、

sentences.zh: 公立学校和报纸这类事物，市场逻辑并不能产生我们想要的

sentences.en: see.
sentences.zh: 结果。
